note: One entry per emission-factor catalog version that a stored row may name. A version's content is immutable once released: tests/catalog-version.test.ts fails when a catalog file no longer matches the sha256 recorded here, so changing any factor, unit, scope rule or label needs a new `version` in emission-factors.json and a new entry here. To release a new version: copy emission-factors.json to emission-factors.v<N>.json and point its entry's `file` at the copy (it is frozen from then on), require() the copy in emission-factors.cjs so rows pinned to it keep resolving, then edit emission-factors.json with the new `version` and add its entry with the new hash. sha256 is over the file with LF line endings.
